The structural collapse of the side mirror (severity 1.0) is a valid observation of soft geometry. The topology boundary auditor's mask shows some irregularity at the bottom left (wheel well area), suggesting potential fusion or segmentation difficulty, which aligns with the Router's focus on boundary sharpness. The image_text_auditor's failure to extract any text confirms the gibberish nature of the plate/sign.

The vehicle structure is coherent and matches the taxonomy description perfectly. The only deduction is for the untestable rear, but since it's occluded, it doesn't penalize alignment. The high score reflects strong class conformance.
artifact_reasoning: The primary artifacts are text-related: the license plate and destination sign contain illegible gibberish, confirmed by the image_text_auditor returning empty results. This is a significant but localized artifact (severity ~2.5). There is also minor structural softness in the side mirror and slight compression noise. These issues prevent a perfect artifact score but do not constitute catastrophic failure. The score is calibrated against Reference 2 (mid-quality, some artifacts) and Reference 3 (high-quality, no artifacts); this image is better than Ref 2 due to strong structural integrity but worse than Ref 3 due to text failures.
